messages.subject: Error installing Natverse in R
messages.body_plain:
Hi All

I want to start using Natverse but I ran into some trouble.
1. R version is 4.1.1
2. R studio version 1.4.1717
3. I have GitHub account and personal access Token (GITHUB_PAT).

Following the installation guide (very clear and easy to follow by the way), I run:

install.packages("natmanager")
natmanager::install('core', force = TRUE)

without any error.

However when I run:

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Error installing Natverse in R
messages.body_plain:
Dear Juan Antonio,

Thanks for your interest in the natverse and sorry for your installation difficulties. My hunch is that you are having a problem with a (very) old version of the Mac X11 library, which is required for 3D visualisation via the rgl package. Could you try installing the current version of Xquartz (X11) from

https://www.xquartz.org/

restarting R and then trying again? If this does not solve the problem can you also return the result of

library(nat)
sessioninfo::session_info()

In a fresh R session.

All the best,

Greg.

messages.body_plain:
Dear Greg,

Sorry for the late reply. Thanks for the help, updating did the trick!

Best wishes,
Rory

On Thursday, August 12, 2021 at 6:13:37 PM UTC+1 jeff...@gmail.com wrote:
> Dear Rory,
>
> Due to changes in upstream packages, natmanager requires an update. Unfortunately the error message is not very specific Have you done this? A good way to do it would be:
>
> natmanager::selfupdate()
>
> If this still does not work, please can you check if the `gh` package is up to date. In fact 95% install issues can be solved by restarting R and updating all packages ( remotes::update_packages() is helpful if you have any packages that came from GitHub)
>
> Maybe you could also report the current value of
>
> gh::gh_token()
>
> To check the you have a new style GitHub token, although I don't think that is the problem.
>
> All the best,
>
> Greg.
>
>
